profile.profileEvidence: Individual local front and supporting profile/oblique source photos; visual proportions, not measured dimensions.

notes: The source front image visibly contains two rows of twenty rim openings. Alpha segmentation alone incorrectly closes them because the rear barrel is visible.
The flat source cannot establish whether every visible opening follows the same hidden passage through the rim; the reconstructed vent depth is illustrative.
